initial_scene: The robot faces the camera behind a table. A gray fabric bag rests on the table with its rear opening flap raised toward the robot. The right arm is on image left; the left hand is open beside the robot's lap on image right.

observed_sequence.action: Bag remains on table with flap raised. Both hands begin low beside the body.
Right arm lifts and reaches toward the image-left edge of the raised opening flap; the hand descends alongside the fabric edge. Left hand remains open near lap.

Right fingers contact the image-left side edge of the flap and guide it down toward the bag. The opposing thumb and edge are partly hidden, so the early contact cannot be cleanly distinguished as pushing versus pinching. The flap becomes low and nearly horizontal; bag body remains on table.
observed_sequence.confidence: high for flap motion and contact; moderate for exact grasp form

observed_sequence.action: Right fingers hold the flap edge as the hand raises it upright again; the thumb appears across the edge, and fabric follows the hand. Left hand remains open and separated from the bag rim, with no visible support.
Right hand maintains edge contact as it lowers flap back toward robot, bending it down on the robot-facing side of the opening. The bag body does not lift with the flap.
Right hand releases flattened flap and lifts clear; flap remains low beside opening.
Right arm retracts to low position and left hand moves slightly outward, with neither hand holding fabric at end. Bag remains on table with flap flat toward robot.

arm_hand_roles.right_hand: Sole visible manipulator: contacts side edge and bends raised fabric flap down toward bag, lifts flap upright while holding its edge, lowers it back toward body, and releases it. Exact early thumb contact is occluded; no mechanism operation is asserted.
arm_hand_roles.left_hand: Remains open beside lap near image-right rim; native frames show no encirclement of fabric, visible grip, or synchronized fabric response. No stabilizing support or transfer is confirmed. Moves slightly away near end.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: No bimanual manipulation is established after separate contact tracing. Right hand manipulates flap while table supports bag body; left proximity is not treated as stabilizing contact.

anatomical_side_evidence.convention: Robot-relative anatomical sides; robot faces camera.
anatomical_side_evidence.right: Active arm can be traced continuously from shoulder on image left through upper arm and elbow to the manipulating hand; this is the robot's right arm.
anatomical_side_evidence.left: Idle open hand on image right connects to robot's left shoulder and elbow.

terminal_state: Bag remains on tabletop. Previously raised opening flap rests flat on the robot-facing side of the opening. Right hand has visibly released it and retracted; left hand is free. No conclusion is made about exact opening width or fastening state.
uncertainties: The right thumb and flap edge are partly occluded during first contact and initial lowering, so an exact push-versus-pinch classification and precise grip onset cannot be established. Edge holding is clearer during the subsequent lift.

The dark fabric and flap obscure the interior opening, so exact opening width and whether a closure is fully open or shut cannot be established. No zipper fastening or unfastening is visibly confirmed.
Left fingertips approach the bag rim in projection during final lowering, but no grip or stabilizing contact is visible; a momentary light touch cannot be excluded from this view.
selected_execution_status_reason: Visible flap adjustment completes and the flap is released in a changed, flat position. This status refers to observed fabric repositioning rather than an inferred fully opened or fastened bag.
